sections.text:
-Decreases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 1000. Deal magic damage (Time) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 80 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Chipped Blade (nullifies effects that penetrate damage reduction or reflection when using an attack Ability) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Erosion (nullifies effects that penetrate nullifying or invulnerability effects when using an attack Ability) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 100 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 3 for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Emerald King's Crest for 120 seconds ([Heraldic] Increases max HP by 500%, increases DEF and MDEF by 100%, increases ATK and MATK for all allies by 100%. Only one Heraldic effect may be active at a time (between both allies and enemies). When a new Heraldic effect is activated, the older effect will be removed. This effect is not affected by Time Slice or Time Extend).
Status ailment resistance boosted by 40 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Dawn for 120 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Light and Dark Defense from Unison Damage +600
Time and Star Defense from Unison Damage +600
